comment: The ONE machine-readable statement of which branches a release consumes, and from which forks.
Why this file exists: the release used to consume ten dependency repositories through three
different mechanisms that could not see each other - Go replace directives in go.mod and
test/go.mod, gitlinks for the three clients, and a nested gitlink inside the Desktop client,
plus the Apple source rule in release/apple-client-refs.env which resolved main at build
time. Nothing compared them, so a pin could lag a fork's product branch for weeks without a
single red build - which is exactly what happened to clients/desktop before v0.1.33.
This file records INTENT (repository + branch + policy). It deliberately records no SHAs:
the SHAs live in go.mod and in the gitlinks, and release/source-lock.json is the snapshot
derived from those. A second copy of a SHA here would be a second truth to keep in sync,
which is the defect the freeze exists to remove.
Moved here from FORK_REPOSITORIES.md and .gitmodules, which stay as the human-readable
inventory and the submodule definitions. scripts/ci/release-freeze.py is the only reader.
policy:
update      - release preparation may move this pin to the branch tip. The move still has
to pass the ABI, module-integrity and build gates; a diverged fork is a
failure, never an automatic merge.
controlled  - never moved by release preparation. Used for the 29 cronet-go native
platform modules, whose archives are built with a Chromium toolchain that
does not exist in this repository; rewriting the SHA without rebuilding and
re-verifying those archives would ship new bindings against old binaries.
report      - resolved and recorded, but never written by release preparation because the
pin lives in ANOTHER repository's tree (Desktop's dashboard gitlink). Moving
it means a commit in that repository first, so the order stays
Dashboard -> Desktop -> kernel.
pinned_on   - documentation only, not read by release-freeze.py: the cronet-go pins are the
publish commits, which live on the `go` generation line, while `branch` names
the source line the release tracks. Changing the cronet `branch` to `go` would
make freeze read the root pin as behind the publish tip and move it without a
native rebuild, which is exactly what `controlled` exists to prevent.

go_modules.note: sing-box's socket/transport/pause layer. Tracks SagerNet/sing dev.

TUN/route/nfqueue stack. Tracks SagerNet/sing-tun dev. The pin now includes the flow-observation branch merged as dev ab63d63: read-only UDP NAT and TCP dispatcher stats, the Go stack first-packet snapshot release fix, and the 2000/4096-flow scale tests. The production code is 938b89d (the measured tree); ab63d63 adds only the scale test commit on top.

The option-to-Config pass-through for QUIC; carries the owned-datagram ceiling. The Q09 fix (per-creation admission across the three shared QUIC clients, TUIC authentication inside the creation) is now main's own tip: c1b074f is both the branch head and the pin, so `check` reports identical, not AHEAD. Re-verified 2026-11-13 by reading main's history in the fork; the older note that called the pin an unmerged fix commit was written while that was true.
The SagerNet module line only. Never the MetaCubeX line; integration/0.1.45 was merged into sagernet on 2026-11-11.
Tracks MetaCubeX/utls v1.9.0-mod-meta; UPSTREAM.md in that repository is the authority.
The AmneziaWG injection line (awg3-inject) consumed through the fork replace; awg-base/awg-graft were archived and deleted on 2026-11-11 after supersession evidence.

The AnyTLS session pool. Consumed for audit Q10: the client asks AdmitCreation only on a real session creation, so reusing an idle session is neither charged nor blocked by the creation budget. Main now carries the creation-coalescing work merged from work/creation-coalescing-2026-11-14: one shared session creation for concurrent first flows, the caller deadline preserved, and a PendingCreationWaiters gauge (8473492 is main's tip). The residual boundary - the external API still cannot answer would-this-dial-reuse before the attempt - stays documented in docs/coupling/ISSUES.md F-06.

The Mieru client SDK. Consumed for audit Q04: a session attach is refused on a closed underlay, and the stream/packet wrappers hold the lifecycle mutex across attach so a teardown cannot observe a half-attached session. The fix was cherry-picked onto main (b5934f7, patch-id identical to 153d0ac) so main's six newer commits are kept; main's tip is now the pin and the temporary fix branch is retired.

Root module: Go bindings for the native engine. Moves with `all`. The exact pin 362e63b14ce2 is the fork's Build from 4c96192d commit, which lives on the publish line `go` (main + build + generate), not on main; `branch` stays main because release-freeze tracks the source line and must not move a controlled-native pin on its own.

The aggregate module. Its publish commit is one ahead of the root: the first publish commit carries the natives (362e63b14ce2), the second regenerates this module and the lib requires (7ce9c49b464a); both live on the `go` line, which is what the two pins name. release-freeze.py verify compares both; `branch` stays main for the same reason as the root entry.

cronet_native.note: The 29 platform archives. They and the root module resolve to the SAME native publish commit (362e63b14ce2) - go.mod says so and this file's earlier claim that the archives were an older SHA than the root was stale; only the `all` aggregate module is one publish commit later (7ce9c49b464a). They stay controlled: the range is never moved by a release preparation or by a branch tip. See go.mod's comment and release/cronet-provenance.txt.

clients.note: One source for iOS and macOS. A formal release must build this exact SHA; release/apple-client-refs.env still allows a manual build to resolve main as a moving target. HELD at the verified aa8e16a on 2026-11-14: main head a867f61 does not compile - both the iOS and macOS jobs of run 43565916842 fail at ProfileCard.swift:627 and ProfilePickerSheet.swift:418 with 'missing argument label report:' in RemoteProfileUpdateAlertError(report). The head is reported, not consumed, until the client is fixed and compiled.
Single product branch since the 2026-10-28 convergence.

Windows client and installer. HELD at a658231 on 2026-11-14 together with Apple: main head 1bd68313 is one app-layer provider-status commit plus dashboard b6e3193, and the client pair is taken as a set only after the Apple head compiles again.

nested.note: The web UI embedded in the Desktop client. Its pin lives in the Desktop repository, so a lag is reported here and fixed there first.

upstream_mirrors.note: Audit baseline only. mirror/meta-v1.9.0 was archived and deleted on 2026-11-11; main already contains v1.9.0-mod-meta.
The kernel's own upstream. Reported so a release states how far the fork has moved, not to be merged by the freeze.
